notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #10⚔️
notes.content:
[h3]In devlog #10 you can see ⚔️Main Characters 🧙 [/h3]
The video demonstrates the main characters of the first act of the game, who will be involved in the prologue. 💫

 
In the footage we can get acquainted with representatives of 2 main factions ☠️ - the Hunter Faction and the Dark Riders. These are the main parties to the conflict🗡️, but not the only ones.

Erwin, the main character of the game, is a representative of the Hunter Faction🔥. During the prologue, the player will face at least 5 big battles ⚔️with representatives of the Dark Riders ⚡️ presented in the videos. In addition to battles, we can also communicate both with members of our faction and with ordinary people, some of whom are presented in the video

More about game SOON. STay Tuned

notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #9⚔️
notes.content:
[h3]In devlog #9 you can see Attribute Affects[/h3]
The [b]prologue version👊[/b] is coming soon⏳, so we continue to improve existing gameplay mechanics and work hard on new ones. In this video, you can see how the [b]attribute effects[/b] system was implemented🆕

[previewyoutube=LJSzqfM6VNI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Attribute effects[/b] - can be used when you manage to fill at least one segment of the attribute point bar.↗️ Depending on the selected attribute - the effect🪄 will be different. Each attribute has its own peculiarities, and their selection will depend on your chosen battle tactics💥. 


Attribute effects work regardless of which weapon🗡️ you are currently using. You can use any [b]weapon[/b]⚡️.

In the future, the effects of this system will be used in other mechanics - [b]skills, bombs, traps,[/b] and so on. This system will make the gameplay [b]deeper[/b] and more interesting. Very soon you will be able to try this and much more on your own! ☄️

tags.feature: In this video, you can see how the [b]attribute effects[/b] system was implemented🆕

notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #7⚔️
notes.content:
[h3]Today is great day[/h3]
we start a series of devlogs about the [b]combat[/b]👊 system 🦾 in ILLUSION LANDS⚔️ - about new features that we have introduced during development and about reworking old ones. Today I will tell you about the Attribute system. 🌀

[b]The Attribute System[/b] enhances weapons 🗡️ by giving them [b]special [/b]properties that can help you in combat. At the moment,[b] 4 attributes[/b] are implemented - Fire🔥, Poison💉, Ice❄️, Bleeding.🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/1376727deaec5b66a016a727458f678c9532c4e9.png[/img]

Depending on the attribute you choose, during the battle you can deal «elemental damage»⚡️ to the enemy💀, poison him, or wound him. If the damage from the attribute is dealt successfully, an indicator will appear above the enemy's HP. 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/f489bd5218604d76ff5dfb0de7ba698835105483.png[/img]

Attributes can be improved⬆️ and upgraded⬆️ . The game has [b]various [/b]items related to this system, which you can find during the exploration of locations🗻.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/b4cd57e1ab9b4a73f6cb68a575048fe69a06f62a.png[/img]
 
Attribute damage can be either chance damage, if we are talking about regular attacks with a bow or sword🗡️ or guaranteed, if you use various used items -[b] bombs💣, traps [/b]and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/eb754306c23bacfc55cfe730f25d1b22e99b79c1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #6⚔️
notes.content:
[h1][b]What can you find in the new devlog?[/b][/h1]

[b]Weapon system ⚔️[/b]

In the world of IL, each Hunter has their own, filled with energy, allowing them to destroy Morbids and Devourers💀. Erwin 🦸 can have 5 types of weapons - Bow, One-Handed Sword, Two-Handed Sword, Double Spear, Dual Swords. The bow 🏹 is a basic weapon and is used independently of melee weapons. Melee weapons in the game have a difference in pace and have a number of unique features. Each weapon can be used in attacks both on the ground and in the air. Each weapon has its own skills that can be improved.

[list]
[*] [b] One-handed sword 🗡️ "ENYO"[/b] is a fast-paced weapon that is effective against almost all types of enemies except for armored ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/efbad162e7632dd63f7f238903b389abee68a931.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/378d3e60b2c6d948bb06860a8e8544f3e498f96c.png[/img]

[*][b]Two-handed sword ⚔️ "VIRTUS"[/b] effective against armored opponents. It can be used on multiple enemies at the same time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/1f9dc985f2c0bc253df1ac4fff4e3cfe405b9011.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/e82e5f10d698f3cb1711b36d71ef9de5c3ca6f71.png[/img]

[*][b] Double spear ⚡️ "NEITH"[/b] is especially effective for duels in the air or for use against large crowds of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/2aadad73dc6ce3c93b4d5c2b392b402cf633704a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/045c9a38558760e1a57618ca5565b8242d7d7c08.png[/img]

[*][b] Dual swords ⚔️ "SATIS"[/b] is the most effective weapon against Devourers, it can be used against any type of enemy and even for ranged attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/91a8a838e543aafcffe376bb658f259c7672c880.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/f61d0312c66315018690dd2defcbadf6b0c3090b.png[/img]
[/list]

Each weapon 🗡️ has its own characteristics, but the game does not limit you in choosing a specific weapon to play IL effectively. You can use one weapon you like, or combine them at your discretion 

[b]Follow the game 👇👇👇 and stay tuned, prologue sooooon![/b] - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174260/Illusion_Lands_Prologue_Defenders_of_Dune/

notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #4⚔️
notes.content:
[h1][b]Glad to welcome you again![/b][/h1]

Next week we will publish a Steam card for the Prologue version🥳 that you should add to your wishlist, and in the near future the demo Prologue itself🐉.  Where you will be able to try out all those new features and items that we have been implementing all this time.

And today we will talk about a new type of weapons that will be in the game. ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/8ed0392ae19f88a16e3b1e3b132af83f10d500f3.png[/img]

There are currently 5 types of weapons in the game. Each appears depending on the level. Each weapon has its own special skills and play style.🏹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/afd02e9072dda65f50e7f11e24bfdec33474b13f.png[/img]

The game also implemented air battles - you can use weapons to attack in the air. Also, some skills only work in the air. You can upgrade the skill tree of some weapons so that it can be used against air targets with maximum effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/8733f80092520898f4bc31d39033d69c2db757e4.png[/img]

Each weapon has its own tempo. The Giant Sword🪓 is the slowest weapon and deals the most damage. Twin blades are the opposite. However, depending on the features of pumping skill branches, you can create a unique build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/58a1b595e5b11d827c0b9fba65ad6cf87e161fa9.png[/img]

In the next devlog, we will show you the features of this or that type of weapon, and later - you can try it out yourself in the newest demo.

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
Greetings, dear members of the IL group. We would like to share with you news about the game and outline further plans for the development of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/6ea35fbf28f5cb1e5db27568430af28b216961ca.jpg[/img]

We took into account many comments and suggestions on the game from the community received during the last Steamfest. Most of the problems have been fixed, and the coolest suggestions have been implemented in the game. Soon you will be able to see it for yourself in the new demo assembly (follow the project news, subscribe to our [url=https://discord.gg/hf4nS8pw]discord[/url]). Also, follow the news of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41670174]curator[/url].

[u][b]Let's move on to the most interesting
[/b][/u]

[b]QUALITY OF SYSTEM MECHANICS:
[/b]

We have improved the quality of most of the key mechanics related to the game system as a whole (which was a lot of questions during Steamfest). All mechanics related to the comfortable process of passing the game have been improved to excellent quality - the save system, localization, gamepad support, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/bee61545626df8fa781595c898224d2c195ebc12.jpg[/img]

Currently tested:

- Keyboard and mouse;
- Steampad;
- Steamdeck;
- Controller from PS4;
- Xbox controller.

Support for gamepads from current consoles will be implemented later.

[b]SKILL SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT:
[/b]

The skill system has been completely redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/db4727668551661f9e63440b2fe38dcc88be3995.jpg[/img]

Now, the character's skills are a branched RPG system, each "branch" of which is responsible for one or another type of weapon.

In addition to the above, we have a lot more to share, but we will not load our devlogs with a lot of text. At this stage, we will publish them systematically, therefore - do not forget to add us on Discord, follow the news in this group and cross the road only at the green light.

See you very, very soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585442/3c38f99351b14d010cdc3322593ef66b4df27c5c.png[/img]
